acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-reader -p stoa-transit passes; allow_http=true with credentials on non-loopback is now a ConfigError::Validation; clippy clean
description:
## What
Add a fatal startup guard in reader and transit config validation: if backend.webdav.allow_http=true (or azure/s3 allow_http=true) AND credentials are configured AND the endpoint host is non-loopback, abort with a fatal error.

## Algorithm
1. Read crates/reader/src/config.rs validate() — find the WebDAV, Azure, S3 backend validation arms.
2. Read crates/transit/src/config.rs validate() — same.
3. For WebDAV: add after existing allow_http check:
     if webdav.allow_http.unwrap_or(false)
         && webdav.password.is_some()
         && !is_loopback_url_host(&webdav.url)
     {
         return Err(ConfigError::Validation(
             format!('backend.webdav.allow_http = true with credentials configured transmits \
your password in cleartext to {}. Set allow_http = false or change the URL to https://', webdav.url)
         ));
     }
4. Add is_loopback_url_host(url: &str) -> bool helper (extract host from URL, call IpAddr::parse or check 'localhost'). Place in the same config.rs or use stoa_core::util if Gap W0A is done first.
5. Apply the same pattern to AzureBackendConfig (allow_http + access_key present + non-loopback endpoint).
6. For S3: add a warning (not yet fatal — S3 credentials are passed in config but the endpoint is typically forced to AWS). Add a warn! for now, document that a future guard will make it fatal once endpoint-checking logic is stable.
7. cargo fmt; cargo clippy clean; cargo test --workspace clean.

## Defensive programming rules
- URL parsing must not panic; on parse error, return false (treat as non-loopback → more restrictive). No unwrap() without comment.
- The error message must include the URL (censored if it contains embedded credentials, but show the host).
- Key material (password, secret_access_key) must NOT appear in the error message or log.

## Tests
Add unit tests in reader/src/config.rs test module:
- test_webdav_allow_http_with_password_nonloopback: Config with webdav allow_http=true, password='secret', url='http://storage.example.com/dav' → validate() returns Err(ConfigError::Validation(...)).  Oracle: the guard condition.
- test_webdav_allow_http_with_password_loopback: same but url='http://127.0.0.1:8080/dav' → validate() returns Ok(). Oracle: loopback is safe.
- test_webdav_allow_http_no_password: allow_http=true, no password, non-loopback url → validate() returns Ok(). Oracle: no credential to expose.
- test_azure_allow_http_with_key_nonloopback: Azure allow_http=true, access_key set, endpoint='http://myprod.blob.core.windows.net' → validate() returns Err(). Oracle: same guard.
title: core/reader/transit: fatal guard for allow_http=true with credentials
